result.instructions: Tools for Zulu, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are overdue, and how much is outstanding in total?"; "Create a draft invoice for Globex Ireland with two shelving units, using the next invoice number."; "Record a bank transfer of 147.60 against invoice INV-0041.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zulu data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zulu_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zulu_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zulu_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zulu_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zulu_get_business
tools.title: Get the business
tools.description: Get the business the API key belongs to: name, details and VAT number. Zulu API: GET /business.

tools.name: zulu_get_plan
tools.title: Get the plan and usage
tools.description: Get the business's plan, its limits and current usage, such as e-mails sent today. Zulu API: GET /business/plan.

tools.name: zulu_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices and credit notes, newest first. Filter by status, type, customer, overdue or part-paid. Zulu API: GET /invoice.

query.description: Search text. Matches the main name or number, ignoring case.

after.description: The last id of the previous page, to get the next page.

before.description: The first id of the current page, to get the previous page.

contact_id.description: Only invoices billed to this customer id.

overdue.description: true: only open invoices past their due date.

part_paid.description: true: only open invoices with some payment received.

tools.name: zulu_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice or credit note by id, with its items, totals, amount due and status. Zulu API: GET /invoice?id=.

tools.name: zulu_get_invoice_summary
tools.title: Get the invoice summary
tools.description: Get totals per currency: outstanding, overdue, and paid and issued this month and last month. Zulu API: GET /invoice/summary.

tools.name: zulu_next_invoice_number
tools.title: Suggest the next invoice number
tools.description: Suggest the next free invoice or credit note number in the business's format. Zulu API: GET /invoice/next-number.

tools.name: zulu_list_invoice_payments
tools.title: List payments received
tools.description: List payments received against invoices, newest first. Pass invoice_id to list one invoice's payments. Zulu API: GET /invoice/payment.

invoice_id.description: Only payments against this invoice id.

query.description: Search text. Matches the main name or number, ignoring case.

after.description: The last id of the previous page, to get the next page.

before.description: The first id of the current page, to get the previous page.

tools.name: zulu_list_invoice_sends
tools.title: List invoice e-mails
tools.description: List when invoices were e-mailed, to whom, and the delivery status. Read only: this tool sends nothing. Zulu API: GET /invoice/send.

invoice_id.description: Only e-mails for this invoice id.

status.description: Only e-mails with this delivery status.

query.description: Search text. Matches the main name or number, ignoring case.

after.description: The last id of the previous page, to get the next page.

before.description: The first id of the current page, to get the previous page.

tools.name: zulu_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (contacts) with their e-mails, phones and addresses. Search by name, or pass id for one customer. Zulu API: GET /contact.

id.description: One customer id. Leave out to list.

query.description: Search text. Matches the main name or number, ignoring case.

after.description: The last id of the previous page, to get the next page.

before.description: The first id of the current page, to get the previous page.

tools.name: zulu_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer with its e-mails, phones and addresses in one request. Zulu API: POST /contact.

tools.name: zulu_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Change a customer's name, company or VAT number. Fields you leave out stay as they are. Zulu API: PATCH /contact.

tools.name: zulu_create_invoice_draft
tools.title: Create a draft invoice
tools.description: Create a draft invoice. A draft can be edited later in Zulu. It is not issued and not e-mailed. Zulu works out totals and VAT. Zulu API: POST /invoice.

name.description: Invoice title, e.g. the job or project name.

number.description: Invoice number, e.g. INV-0042. See zulu_next_invoice_number.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR. Default EUR.

contact_id.description: The customer to bill (customer id). Zulu copies their details.

catalog_id.description: A saved item id. Zulu copies its name, price and VAT.

unit_price.description: Amount as a string with up to 2 decimals, e.g. "120.50".

vat_id.description: A VAT rate id for this line.

tools.name: zulu_record_invoice_payment
tools.title: Record a payment
tools.description: Record money received against an open invoice, in full or in part. It cannot be more than the amount due. Zulu API: POST /invoice/payment.

amount.description: Amount as a string with up to 2 decimals, e.g. "120.50".

date.description: When the money arrived. Default: today (Irish time).

reference.description: A bank reference or receipt number.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Zulu
prompts.description: What you can do with Zulu here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_overdue_invoices
prompts.title: Find overdue invoices
prompts.description: List the invoices, filtered to the overdue ones. Read the invoice summary for the total outstanding amount.

prompts.name: check_who_received_an_invoice_e_mail
prompts.title: Check who received an invoice e-mail
prompts.description: List the invoice e-mails with the recipient and delivery status. This tool sends nothing.

prompts.name: create_a_draft_invoice
prompts.title: Create a draft invoice
prompts.description: Suggest the next invoice number. Then create a draft invoice. The draft is not issued or e-mailed.

prompts.name: record_a_bank_transfer
prompts.title: Record a bank transfer
prompts.description: Read the invoice, then record the payment against it. The payment cannot be more than the amount due.
